business_summary.text: Kuantum Papers Ltd is a leading agro and wood-based paper manufacturer operating a fully integrated facility in Hoshiarpur, Punjab.

lab.quote: Paper Machine 2 rebuild was completed in March 2026, enhancing its installed capacity to 75 tons per day through major upgrades, including dilution control headbox, upgraded press section, wire part extension, DCS and QCS modules, additional dryers, Kusters calendars for control, tail shooters and dry end improvement.

call_memory.quote: Paper Machine 2 rebuild was completed in March 2026, enhancing its installed capacity to 75 tons per day through major upgrades, including dilution control headbox, upgraded press section, wire part extension, DCS and QCS modules, additional dryers, Kusters calendars for control, tail shooters and dry end improvement.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Paper Machine 2 rebuild was completed in March 2026, enhancing its installed capacity to 75 tons per day through major upgrades.

lab.quote: A synchro sheeter with a capacity of 80 tons per day was also installed, which will ensure cutting of sheets with higher precision and efficiency and thus will allow elimination of manual handling of sheets for online packing.

call_memory.quote: A synchro sheeter with a capacity of 80 tons per day was also installed, which will ensure cutting of sheets with higher precision and efficiency and thus will allow elimination of manual handling of sheets for online packing.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: A synchro sheeter with a capacity of 80 tons per day was installed to ensure cutting of sheets with higher precision and efficiency.

lab.quote: The Displacement Digester System, the DDS project for wood pulping has achieved significant progress and is currently under extensive testing, with commissioning targeted by mid-June.

call_memory.quote: The Displacement Digester System, the DDS project for wood pulping has achieved significant progress and is currently under extensive testing, with commissioning targeted by mid-June.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The Displacement Digester System for wood pulping is under extensive testing, with commissioning targeted by mid-June.

lab.quote: On the plant operations front, post the rebuild of PM1 in December 2025, the average daily production for the quarter 4 has increased by almost 20 tons per day on this machine.

call_memory.quote: On the plant operations front, post the rebuild of PM1 in December 2025, the average daily production for the quarter 4 has increased by almost 20 tons per day on this machine.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Average daily production for quarter 4 increased by almost 20 tons per day on PM1 post its rebuild in December 2025.

lab.quote: On the environment and sustainability front, we added 854 acres of social farm forestry during the quarter, taking the total area under plantation to more than 18,300 acres and benefiting over 19,100 farmers in the community.

call_memory.quote: On the environment and sustainability front, we added 854 acres of social farm forestry during the quarter, taking the total area under plantation to more than 18,300 acres and benefiting over 19,100 farmers in the community.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total area under social farm forestry plantation stands at more than 18,300 acres, benefiting over 19,100 farmers.

lab.quote: operational income stood at INR301 crores, registering a sequential growth of 4%, primarily driven by an improved NSR of INR3,700 per metric ton.

call_memory.quote: operational income stood at INR301 crores, registering a sequential growth of 4%, primarily driven by an improved NSR of INR3,700 per metric ton.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Operational income for Q4 FY26 stood at INR301 crores, registering a sequential growth of 4%.

lab.quote: During the quarter, input costs increased by nearly INR2,000 per metric ton due to higher raw material, chemical and fuel prices amid the ongoing West Asia conflict.

call_memory.quote: During the quarter, input costs increased by nearly INR2,000 per metric ton due to higher raw material, chemical and fuel prices amid the ongoing West Asia conflict.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Input costs increased by nearly INR2,000 per metric ton during the quarter due to higher raw material, chemical and fuel prices amid the ongoing West Asia conflict.

lab.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR48 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 22% quarter-on-quarter, while EBITDA margins improved significantly to 15.90%, representing an expansion of 234 basis points on quarter-on-quarter basis.

call_memory.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR48 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 22% quarter-on-quarter, while EBITDA margins improved significantly to 15.90%, representing an expansion of 234 basis points on quarter-on-quarter basis.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 stood at INR48 crores, reflecting a growth of 22% quarter-on-quarter with EBITDA margins at 15.90%.

lab.quote: EBITDA margins improved significantly to 15.90%, representing an expansion of 234 basis points on quarter-on-quarter basis.

call_memory.quote: EBITDA margins improved significantly to 15.90%, representing an expansion of 234 basis points on quarter-on-quarter basis.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: EBITDA margins expanded by 234 basis points on a quarter-on-quarter basis to 15.90% in Q4 FY26.

lab.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR14 crores, registering a healthy growth of 46% quarter-on-quarter with PAT margins improving to 4.75%, an expansion of 137 basis points sequentially.

call_memory.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR14 crores, registering a healthy growth of 46% quarter-on-quarter with PAT margins improving to 4.75%, an expansion of 137 basis points sequentially.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Profit after tax for Q4 FY26 stood at INR14 crores, with PAT margins improving to 4.75%.

lab.quote: The margin pressure was primarily driven by a reduction in NSR of approximately INR2,000 per metric ton, coupled with an increase in cost of nearly INR3,200 per metric ton.

call_memory.quote: The margin pressure was primarily driven by a reduction in NSR of approximately INR2,000 per metric ton, coupled with an increase in cost of nearly INR3,200 per metric ton.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: FY26 margin pressure was driven by a reduction in NSR of approximately INR2,000 per metric ton and an increase in cost of nearly INR3,200 per metric ton.

lab.quote: So currently, pulp pricing is in the range of $600 to $700 per ton depending on whether it's hardwood pulp or softwood pulp.

call_memory.quote: So currently, pulp pricing is in the range of $600 to $700 per ton depending on whether it's hardwood pulp or softwood pulp.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Global pulp pricing is currently in the range of $600 to $700 per ton.

lab.quote: So, it's on -- planning it in by mid-June.

call_memory.quote: So, it's on -- planning it in by mid-June.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Upgradation of PM 3 is planned to be completed by mid-June.

lab.quote: So the peak debt will be in between 650 to 675 by end of 2027.

call_memory.quote: So the peak debt will be in between 650 to 675 by end of 2027.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Long-term debt as on 31st March stood at INR720 crores, and is expected to peak between INR650 crores to INR675 crores by end of 2027.

lab.quote: On that front, we have already the remaining capex of around INR125 crores, which will be expensed out during this year.

call_memory.quote: On that front, we have already the remaining capex of around INR125 crores, which will be expensed out during this year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Remaining capex of around INR125 crores will be expensed out during FY27.

lab.quote: Annual repayment is almost in between INR170 crores to INR180 crores per year in next 2, 3 years.

call_memory.quote: Annual repayment is almost in between INR170 crores to INR180 crores per year in next 2, 3 years.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Annual debt repayment is expected to be almost between INR170 crores to INR180 crores per year in the next 2 to 3 years.

lab.quote: and also the specialty paper segment, which we're going to focus on and increase it to about 25%, 30% of our entire production volume.

call_memory.quote: and also the specialty paper segment, which we're going to focus on and increase it to about 25%, 30% of our entire production volume.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company aims to increase the specialty paper segment to about 25% to 30% of its entire production volume.

lab.quote: This was a conscious call and intentionally, intentional decision to reduce the percentage from 20% plus to less than 10% and which, over time, will gradually be eliminated because with GST at 0, we have to reverse appropriate tax input credit and which is quite a cost to us.

call_memory.quote: This was a conscious call and intentionally, intentional decision to reduce the percentage from 20% plus to less than 10% and which, over time, will gradually be eliminated because with GST at 0, we have to reverse appropriate tax input credit and which is quite a cost to us.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company is intentionally exiting the notebook paper segment due to the cost impact of reversing input tax credits under 0% GST.

lab.quote: But the good part is that even if the cost of our pulp increases due to this pulp content, the quality, it has a beneficial impact and a favourable impact on the quality of paper and which, in turn, allows us to increase our sales realization in the market.

call_memory.quote: But the good part is that even if the cost of our pulp increases due to this pulp content, the quality, it has a beneficial impact and a favourable impact on the quality of paper and which, in turn, allows us to increase our sales realization in the market.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company expects that higher quality paper produced from better pulp will allow for increased sales realization, offsetting potential pulp cost increases.

timeline.summary: Pavan Khaitan (Promoter) declared no encumbrance on Kuantum Papers shares for FY2026, with zero promoter-held shares encumbered as of March 31, 2026.

Kuantum Papers Limited’s promoters—Kapedome Enterprises Limited, Jagesh Kumar Khaitan, J K Khaitan (HUF), Pavan Khaitan, Aparna Khaitan, and Usha Khaitan—declared no encumbrances on shares as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹300.94 Cr (+8.5% YoY), net profit ₹14.34 Cr (-45.1% YoY).
Kuantum Papers Limited hosted Q4-FY26/FY26 earnings conference call on 29.05.2026, with audio recording available at www.kuantumpapers.com.
Kuantum Papers reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹301 Cr and net profit of ₹14 Cr, completing major machine upgrades.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹279.1 Cr (-0.2% YoY), net profit ₹2.24 Cr (-61.2% YoY).
Kuantum Papers released its Q2FY27 investor presentation highlighting operational performance and mill expansion updates.
Audio recording of Kuantum Papers Limited's earnings conference call held on 30.10.2026 is available on company website.
Kuantum Papers announced the resignation of CFO Vikram Kumar Khaitan effective October 31, 2026.
